 Order

Dated this the 7th day of November, 2024 This Criminal Miscellaneous Case has been filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, to quash all further proceedings against the petitioner in C.C.No.1384/2022 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-II, Kollam,
pursuant to Annexure A complaint.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Petitioner herein is the accused in the above case.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned counsel appearing for the complainant.
3. In this matter, prosecution alleges commission of offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, by the accused.
4. In this matter, cognizance for the above offence was taken by the Magistrate acting on a private complaint filed by the 2nd respondent.
2024:KER:83132 5. An affidavit sworn by the complainant has been placed stating that the matter has been settled in between them and she has no grievance in the matter of quashing the proceedings.
6. The learned counsel appearing for the complainant also conceded the settlement.
7. Since the matter has been amicably settled between the parties, there is no reason to disallow the prayer for quashment, so as to retain them in hazards of litigation.
Therefore, in the interest of justice, I am inclined to allow this petition.
In the result, this petition stands allowed.
All further proceedings against the petitioner/accused in C.C.No.1384/2022 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-II, Kollam pursuant to Annexure A complaint stand quashed.
